title: Why does NS have to be secure HTTPS for writing only ?
symptom: The user wants to use Nightscout (NS) on a Raspberry Pi 4 with HTTPS disabled, but AndroidAPS forces HTTPS for writing to NS, preventing the user from using HTTP.
cause: The maintainer MilosKozak explains that HTTPS is enforced to prevent non-skilled users from disabling it without understanding the risks, because AAPS can be controlled through NS.
fix: The maintainer suggests that IT professionals can change the code themselves or use a VPN, but no specific code change is provided. The user indicates they have started changing the code themselves.
evidence_quote: making it configurable (disable https if it doesn't work for me) would lead to situation where non skilled users would just disable it as a resolution without evaluating the risk(s). And risk is high because you can control AAPS through NS.
